$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is the number at the start of a case's title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-retailer/SCENARIOS.md. Rowanmere Group, its suppliers and every record are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

The difference of USD 356.50 is a deduction under debit note DBN-0412: USD 310.00 net and USD 46.50 tax. The reason recorded is 50 kg of green peppers rejected at receipt as soft, 50 kg at 6.20.

Rowanmere Group accounts payable
